EN: At the gleeful crack of her whip, DaDa Yuah commands urgency and impatience in the hearts of mortals. To get stuff done, to reach greater speeds, or simply lose oneself to existential anxiety. Once that fear is allowed to fester, she inevitably becomes the angry little devil on their heels. [br/][br/]Before her, dash the Bolting Houndmasters, hunters of laggardly spirits and all those who eventually tarry before the infernal whip of impatience. They are the rabid and restless servants of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DemonicOverlordLoreConcept]Harridanmother[/hyperlink], and they must not, and cannot sit idle.
PTBR: Ao estalar alegre de seu chicote, DaDa Yuah impõe urgência e impaciência nos corações dos mortais. Para fazer as coisas, alcançar maiores velocidades ou simplesmente perder‑se na ansiedade existencial. Quando esse medo é permitido proliferar, ela inevitavelmente se torna o pequeno demônio irritado nos calcanhares deles. [br/][br/]À sua frente, correm os Mestres dos Cães Galopantes, caçadores de espíritos lentos e de todos que acabam demorando diante do chicote infernal da impaciência. Eles são os servos rabugentos e inquietos da [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DemonicOverlordLoreConcept]Mãe Carrancuda[/hyperlink], e não podem, nem devem ficar inertes.

EN: The Disciple of Ilandra has taken upon herself to defend the {GLOBAL.PellariLoreConcept.Hyperlink}, becoming a paragon among her kind. For it is rare to see one of the animalistic folk of {GLOBAL.DuathaLoreConcept.Hyperlink} ascend to Godirhood. As a native of the realm, Auntie Lobelia enjoys the favor of the {GLOBAL.DuathadaeLoreConcept.Hyperlink}, who regard her actions with far greater benevolence—at least compared to the other disciples in the Circle of Witherbloom. [br/][br/]The ancient tongues tell that the Skittish Pellari were already there when the Fey first came into being. And when the latter took control and became the favorites of Duatha, the fearful hares endured by retreating deep into the Burrow Downs. To them, fear is not cowardice, but survival.
PTBR: A Discípula de Ilandra assumiu a tarefa de defender o {GLOBAL.PellariLoreConcept.Hyperlink}, tornando-se um exemplar entre seu povo. Pois é raro ver um dos seres animalísticos de {GLOBAL.DuathaLoreConcept.Hyperlink} ascender à condição de Godir. Como nativa do reino, Tia Lobelia goza da afeição dos {GLOBAL.DuathadaeLoreConcept.Hyperlink}, que consideram suas ações com muito mais benevolência, ao menos em comparação com as outras discípulas do Círculo de Witherbloom. [br/][br/]As línguas antigas dizem que os Pellari Nervosos já estavam lá quando os Feéricos surgiram. E quando estes tomaram o controle e se tornaram os favoritos de Duatha, as coelhinhas temerosas sobreviveram recuando profundamente para os Burrow Downs. Para elas, o medo não é covardia, mas sobrevivência.

EN: Kana and Grump were once two chieftains of the Blood Clan, distant, degenerate descendants of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MyrridaLoreConcept]Myrrida's[/hyperlink] mighty [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GiantKingLoreConcept]Giant Kings[/hyperlink]. In a feud, the two rival tribes fought each other to extinction. Only Grump survived; he devoured the body of Kana and grafted her head onto himself in the delirium of battle. Thus, they became one, the Twineater. [br/][br/]Lured to {GLOBAL.DuathaLoreConcept.Hyperlink}, Kana-Grump became the Disciple of Ventrogh in the Circle of Witherbloom, leading the Voracious Vermin. Those known to be the most ravenous inhabitants of the realm, insatiable creatures willing to devour even themselves under the orders of their gluttonous master. The rodent pest have eagerly taken up the task of hunting rebels beneath Duatha's surface. A place they call, in hungry whispers, Marrow Downs.
PTBR: Kana e Grump foram, um dia, dois chefes do Clã Sangrento, descendentes distantes e degenerados dos [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MyrridaLoreConcept]Myrrida's[/hyperlink] poderosos [hyperlink,GLOBAL.GiantKingLoreConcept]Reis Gigantes[/hyperlink]. Em uma rivalidade, as duas tribos opostas lutaram até a extinção. Apenas Grump sobreviveu; devorou o corpo de Kana e enxertou sua cabeça em si mesmo no delírio da batalha. Assim, tornaram‑se um só, o Devorador de Cordas. [br/][br/]Atraído para {GLOBAL.DuathaLoreConcept.Hyperlink}, Kana‑Grump tornou‑se o Discípulo de Ventrogh no Círculo de Witherbloom, liderando os Vermes Vorazes. Conhecidos como os habitantes mais famintos do reino, criaturas insaciáveis dispostas a devorar até a si mesmas sob as ordens de seu mestre glutão. A praga roedora assumiu ansiosamente a tarefa de caçar rebeldes sob a superfície de Duatha. Um lugar que chamam, em sussurros famintos, de Marrow Downs.

EN: Bound and taken captive, our jovial Ham Binger was brought before the {GLOBAL.DuathadaeLoreConcept.Hyperlink}. But just before he was devoured, a strange Fey magic whisked him away... once again. In his defense, this time not even he knows how it happened. Yet now he has become the Chosen of the Fey and the leader of the Burrow Downs rebellion. [br/][br/]The Burrowing Pellari welcomed Ham with open paws. Changed by Fey magic, he has fully embraced life among the {GLOBAL.PellariLoreConcept.Hyperlink}. It has been a long time since the Burrow Warden has felt like he belongs. And so, his days of running are over; it is time to defend his home.
PTBR: Amarrado e feito prisioneiro, nosso jovial Ham Binger foi levado perante o {GLOBAL.DuathadaeLoreConcept.Hyperlink}. Mas, pouco antes de ser devorado, uma estranha magia feérica o arrebatou... mais uma vez. Em sua defesa, desta vez nem ele sabe como aconteceu. Contudo, agora ele se tornou o Escolhido dos Feéricos e o líder da rebelião de Burrow Downs. [br/][br/]Os Pellari Escavadores receberam Ham de patas abertas. Transformado pela magia feérica, ele abraçou plenamente a vida entre os {GLOBAL.PellariLoreConcept.Hyperlink}. Faz muito tempo que o Guardião da Toca não se sente pertencente. E assim, seus dias de fuga acabaram; é hora de defender seu lar.

Istarnech Gold-Curser, he who denied the {GLOBAL.AllfatherLoreConcept.Hyperlink} before his peers and ate several treasures of the {GLOBAL.EternalCouncilLoreConcept.Hyperlink}. For this, he was chased out and down before finding shelter in eternal devotion to "the Need." [br/][br/]The Avaricious Wolves are a terribly greedy bunch. All are born in servitude to the Demon Overlord of Avarice, thus their loyalty lies not so much with Istarnech, but rather with the giant hole in his stomach that litters all the treasures he eats across the floor.

Todos nascem a serviço do Suserano Demônio da Avareza, portanto sua lealdade não está tanto a Istarnech, mas ao enorme buraco em seu estômago que espalha todos os tesouros que ele devora pelo chão.

EN: Perisher of weaker hearts and prime Aspect of Chaos: Karissa—formerly "the Red"—whose dormant, primal being has been liberated by the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EndailonLoreConcept]Chaos Endailon[/hyperlink]. Now, she is reborn as "the Fury," harbinger of change, undoer of order, and the indomitable spark destined to set the {GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept.Hyperlink} ablaze—one heart at a time. Through her, Chaos shall reign completely across the {GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept.Hyperlink}, and the old order shall be buried under her raging heels. And a new one shall arise from its ashes, one where all shall praise her. Praise her and rage on! [br/][br/]The Enchanted Chaotes are but savage animals in the eyes of orderly mortals, but they care nothing for such idle judgments. For they are the followers of Karissa and her very weapons of undoing, before whom all shall ultimately perish. "For Chaos! For Karissa!" they shout in their rampant march, "Our One and Only Mistress!" And they are marching for your gates.
PTBR: Perseguidora de corações mais fracos e principal Aspecto do Caos: Karissa, antigamente "a Vermelha", cujo ser adormecido e primitivo foi libertado pelo [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EndailonLoreConcept]Chaos Endailon[/hyperlink]. Agora, ela renasce como "a Fúria", arauto da mudança, desfazedora da ordem, e a faísca indomável destinada a incinerar o {GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept.Hyperlink} em chamas, um coração de cada vez. Por meio dela, o Caos dominará completamente o {GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept.Hyperlink}, e a velha ordem será sepultada sob seus calcanhares furiosos. E um novo surgirá de suas cinzas, onde todos a louvarão. Louvem-na e enfureçam-se! [br/][br/]Os Chaotes Encantados não passam de animais selvagens aos olhos dos mortais ordeiros, mas não se importam com tais julgamentos ociosos. Pois são seguidores de Karissa e de suas próprias armas de destruição, perante as quais todos acabarão. "Pelo Caos! Por Karissa!" gritam em sua marcha desenfreada, "Nossa Única e Soberana Mestra!" E marcham rumo aos seus portões.

EN: After attacking the {GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept.Hyperlink} as an {GLOBAL.EldritchSovereignLoreConcept.Hyperlink} in the {GLOBAL.GreatUmbralWarLoreConcept.Hyperlink}, Merlin was at last freed from [hyperlink,GLOBAL.UrrathLoreConcept]Urrath's[/hyperlink] grasp on the Cliffs of Sordünn. Now the voices are gone, but not the guilt. Unable to trust himself, the Tarnished Archmage has covered his body with spells, wards, and amulets, going so far as to inscribe them into his own flesh. Damping his magic powers for the safety of those he swore to protect.[br/][br/]The {GLOBAL.HorwyndLoreConcept.Hyperlink} are an ancient and secretive people. When the {GLOBAL.CircleOfDeogaiLoreConcept.Hyperlink} were formed in ages past, the Horwynd devised the Shrouded Isles to undermine Archon supremacy. Though they only insinuate their motives for doing so or for seeking out Merlin at this point of time.

Agora as vozes se foram, mas não a culpa. Incapaz de confiar em si mesmo, o Arcanista Manchado cobriu seu corpo com feitiços, proteções e amuletos, chegando a gravá-los em sua própria carne. Atenuando seus poderes mágicos para a segurança daqueles a quem jurou proteger. [br/][br/]Os {GLOBAL.HorwyndLoreConcept.Hyperlink} são um povo antigo e secreto. Quando o {GLOBAL.CircleOfDeogaiLoreConcept.Hyperlink} foi formado em eras passadas, os Horwynd criaram as Ilhas Encobertas para minar a supremacia dos Arcontes. Embora apenas insinuem seus motivos para tal ou para buscar Merlin neste momento.

EN: As life evolves in the {GLOBAL.WorldsWithinLoreConcept.Hyperlink}, so too does death. Nekron has ascended into a new and even [hyperlink,GLOBAL.EldritchSovereignLoreConcept]more corrupted form[/hyperlink], with the power of {GLOBAL.UrrathLoreConcept.Hyperlink} coursing through his necrotic body. The Archreaper now masters every domain of undead magic, and he intends to spread them to bring an Age of Death to the entire {GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept.Hyperlink}.[br/][br/]After the seals on {GLOBAL.AthlaLoreConcept.Hyperlink} were broken, Nekron did not join the invasion of the {GLOBAL.ShadraiFactionLoreConcept.Hyperlink}. Instead, he waited until he could return to Evermore unnoticed. There, he has been raising the Evermore Wights, lingering souls of the elves who once sought their last peace beyond Athla.

O ArquiCeifador agora domina todos os domínios da magia dos mortos‑vivos, e pretende espalhá‑los para trazer uma Era da Morte a todo o {GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept.Hyperlink}. [br/][br/]Depois que os selos de {GLOBAL.AthlaLoreConcept.Hyperlink} foram quebrados, Nekron não se juntou à invasão do {GLOBAL.ShadraiFactionLoreConcept.Hyperlink}. Em vez disso, esperou até poder retornar a Evermore sem ser notado. Lá, tem criado os Wights de Evermore, almas persistentes dos elfos que buscaram sua última paz além de Athla.

EN: At his young age, Palas had already achieved the rank of Master Archivist, guarding the knowledge and secrets of the Great Library of Xandrias. Yet his curiosity led him to read a grimoire from the forbidden section, which cursed his eyes, nearly shattered his sanity, and unleashed dark powers within his library. [br/][br/]The Cryptic Archivists were once part of the {GLOBAL.SchoolOfShroudingLoreConcept.Hyperlink}. But obsessed by lost magic, they drifted away from the {GLOBAL.HorwyndLoreConcept.Hyperlink}. Now Palas and the laconic librarians look for a master. Someone capable of teaching them how to keep the dark secrets of the library under control.

Alguém capaz de ensiná-los a manter sob controle os segredos sombrios da biblioteca.

EN: Distant descendants of the {GLOBAL.HorwyndLoreConcept.Hyperlink}, the ancestors of Soaring Boltwing lived for generations alongside the Dwarves of an exiled realm. Yet the pride of the Vindicator chafed against the restraints and limitations imposed by those he deemed inferior, mere "cave-dwellers." And so, he led his people away, seeking a place where his kind would be granted the honor they deserved. [br/][br/]The Skyshatter Fowl arrived in {GLOBAL.DuathaLoreConcept.Hyperlink} with their leader, who became the Disciple of Luth in the Circle of Witherbloom. In his wake, they claimed what they saw as their rightful place, hunting those who dwell beneath the surface. A fitting twist of fate, one that surely amuses the proud birds.
PTBR: Distantes descendentes dos {GLOBAL.HorwyndLoreConcept.Hyperlink}, os ancestrais de Soarin Asa do Raio viveram por gerações ao lado dos Anões de um reino exilado. Contudo, o orgulho do Vindicador ressentia-se das restrições e limitações impostas por aqueles que considerava inferiores, meros "habitantes das cavernas". Assim, conduziu seu povo para longe, buscando um lugar onde sua espécie fosse agraciada com a honra que merecia.[br/][br/]O Pássaro Quebra-Céus chegou a {GLOBAL.DuathaLoreConcept.Hyperlink} com seu líder, que se tornou Discípulo de Luth no Círculo de Witherbloom. Em sua esteira, reivindicaram o que consideravam seu direito, caçando aqueles que habitam sob a superfície. Um giro do destino adequado, que certamente diverte as orgulhosas aves.

EN: Exiled as a child with dangerous magic abilities, Symon learned the hard way what it means to be different. When the wizards of Evermore had left {GLOBAL.AthlaLoreConcept.Hyperlink} in pursuit of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadowDemonsLoreConcept]Shadow Demons[/hyperlink], Symon followed his sensitive arcane instincts to Evermore, where he found an Eldritch Leviathan waking up beneath the island. With great presence of mind Symon enchanted the Leviathan back into sleep, keeping solitary vigil while Athla became locked from Evermore through the seals of the Third Age. During this time Symon studied the cosmic secrets left behind by the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CircleOfDeogaiLoreConcept]Circle[/hyperlink], but over time the endless struggle with the Leviathan and its desire to break free have taken their toll.[br/][br/]The Flowborn Halflings are a reflection of Symon's solitude, phantom images created to fight against the isolation and sorrow of being forgotten. They are a masterwork of illusion, almost a perfect remembrance of that distant memory when he was happy.
PTBR: Exilado ainda criança com habilidades mágicas perigosas, Symon aprendeu da maneira mais difícil o que significa ser diferente. Quando os magos de Evermore deixaram {GLOBAL.AthlaLoreConcept.Hyperlink} em busca dos [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ShadowDemonsLoreConcept]Demônios das Sombras[/hyperlink], Symon seguiu seus instintos arcanos sensíveis até Evermore, onde encontrou um Leviatã Arcano despertando sob a ilha. Com grande presença de espírito, Symon encantou o Leviatã de volta ao sono, mantendo vigília solitária enquanto Athla ficou selada de Evermore pelos selos da Terceira Era. Nesse período, Symon estudou os segredos cósmicos deixados pelo [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CircleOfDeogaiLoreConcept]Círculo[/hyperlink], mas, com o tempo, a luta interminável contra o Leviatã e seu desejo de libertar‑se cobrou seu preço.[br/][br/]Os Halflings Nascidos do Fluxo são um reflexo da solidão de Symon, imagens fantasmagóricas criadas para combater o isolamento e a tristeza de ser esquecido. São uma obra‑prima de ilusão, quase uma lembrança perfeita daquela memória distante em que ele era feliz.

EN: The antisaint of all forsaken souls, who is whispered to govern the power to undo misfortune, illness, and even old age. In darkness and in shame, Walburgis is the last refuge of many shunned and forgotten mortals who desperately summon him into their hearts each night, even though he is foul and his fruits are rotten. [br/][br/]The Bloodgurgler Legion is believed to be the physical manifestation of the [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DemonicOverlordLoreConcept]Great Bloodgurgler[/hyperlink], who moves through the spirits of his foul and filthy children. To eat the sickly and the elderly and gurgle up their rotten ichor whenever they bleat out in relish, or in their hideous warcries.
PTBR: O antissanto de todas as almas abandonadas, sussurrado como aquele que governa o poder de desfazer infortúnios, doenças e até a velhice. Na escuridão e na vergonha, Walburgis é o último refúgio de muitos mortais rejeitados e esquecidos que o invocam desesperadamente em seus corações a cada noite, embora ele seja repugnante e seus frutos estejam podres.[br/][br/]A Legião dos Gurguladores de Sangue é considerada a manifestação física do [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DemonicOverlordLoreConcept]Grande Gurgulador de Sangue[/hyperlink], que perambula pelos espíritos de seus filhos imundos e sujos. Ele devora os enfermos e os idosos, engolindo seu ícor podre sempre que eles relincham de prazer, ou em seus horríveis gritos de guerra.

EN: He who smote {GLOBAL.ObbadothLoreConcept.Hyperlink} into submission. Ysariel, son of [hyperlink,GLOBAL.MalielLoreConcept]Maliel[/hyperlink], a lonesome, "fallen [hyperlink,GLOBAL.ArchonsLoreConcept]Archon[/hyperlink]" who, after countless failed attempts, eventually established the infamous [hyperlink,GLOBAL.CircleOfDeogaiLoreConcept]Circle of the Azh'Ruun Pit[/hyperlink] through an illicit pact—after which he was banished from Emnora. Now, abandoned by his own and twisted through millennia of forsaken servitude, Ysariel has become the only thing standing between the {GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept.Hyperlink} and the raging [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DemonicOverlordLoreConcept]Demon Overlords[/hyperlink], bound below the Pit. [br/][br/]In this mission, he stands united with the Brotherhood of Ysariel, his sworn Pact Brothers and Sisters, who stand by his side, forever. As does he, by theirs—through fire and temptation.

Agora, abandonado pelos seus e torcido por milênios de servidão esquecida, Ysariel tornou-se a única coisa que se ergue entre o {GLOBAL.AstralSeaLoreConcept.Hyperlink} e os furiosos [hyperlink,GLOBAL.DemonicOverlordLoreConcept]Suseranos Demônios[/hyperlink], aprisionados sob a Abismo.
